messages:
incident-bot: [PAGING] SLO breach detected: streaming.gateway.p99 = 1.35s (5m window) >= p99 SLO 1.2s. Error: increased chunking stalls + proxy write timeouts. Impact: some SSE/WebSocket streams showing long pauses or single huge chunk at end. Paging SRE oncall @Maya (runbook: streaming-tail).
Maya (oncall): Acked. Joining. Who's on runtime? sam?
Sam (runtime): I'm here — seeing elevated write latency from proxy pool (proxy-2/3). Backend runtime token generation steady. Metrics: p95=320ms -> 720ms, p99=1.35s -> 2.1s for streaming responses. Client-side observed: long buffering then burst of ~8-12k bytes.
Lia (prodops): Customer reports: delayed stream updates in live-collab customers, 3 major tenants reporting partial responses. CS alerted. Raj, can you confirm which tenants?
Raj (cust-success): Confirmed: AcmeChat, NoteFlow, and Streamly have session logs showing gaps ~12–18s. They've noticed reconnections. Escalating to account teams.
Maya (oncall): Thanks. Quick triage: is this proxy queueing or backend KV cache stall? Sam, any recent deploys?
Sam (runtime): No runtime deploys in past hour. Noticed increased TCP retransmits from proxy->edge. Also per-proxy fd usage spikes. Checking proxy logs now.
Sam (runtime): Log snip: ```proxy-2 ERROR write_timeout to client_id=abc123 stream_id=zzzz: wrote 0/4096 after 12s -> ERR_TIMEOUT```
Maya (oncall): Hm. That looks like slow consumer/backpressure at the client or ALB behavior. Any sign of slow consumer eviction?
Sam (runtime): evict-slow-client job not triggering; heartbeat mismatches for some clients: ```heartbeat: expected=1 got=0 client=streamly-457```
Lia (prodops): Incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/9755550000 (linked) — adding oncall runbook steps.
Maya (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Temporarily enable drop-slow-clients (feature flag) on streaming gateway 2) Rotate proxy-2 out of pool 3) Increase streaming-proxy write timeout to 30s -> but that might just delay detection. 4) If needed, disable keepalive reuse for clients causing bursts. Prioritize customer impact mitigation.
Sam (runtime): I can rotate proxy-2 out. Currently drain shows ~120 active streams. I'll drain and restart. Doing: `kubectl scale deployment streaming-proxy-2 --replicas=0 --namespace=prod`
Sam (runtime): Drain started. Notifying LB to stop new connections to proxy-2.
Maya (oncall): Flagging drop-slow-clients now (ff:streaming.drop_slow_client=true) on canary (10% of edge). Rolling to 50% if stable.
Lia (prodops): Flag flipped on canary. Monitoring p99.
Sam (runtime): proxy-2 pods terminated & replaced. New pod healthy. p99 dropped slightly to 1.1s in canary region.
Maya (oncall): Good sign. Continue watch. Also add temporary request-level chunking: max_chunk_size=2048 to reduce big-burst writes. Sam can you set that on the canary gateway?
Sam (runtime): Applying chunk size override on canary: `POST /internal/flags {"max_chunk_bytes":2048}` -> 200 OK.
Sam (runtime): p95 now ~480ms, p99 ~950ms on canary. Still above baseline but improving.
Raj (cust-success): AcmeChat reports fewer reconnections in canary region; NoteFlow still seeing some stutters (EU region).
Maya (oncall): EU region not on canary. Lia, please trigger rollout to eu-edge after quick smoke.
Lia (prodops): Rolling flag + proxy rotation to eu-edge. ETA ~6min.
Sam (runtime): EU rollout started. Also enabling additional logging for slowconsumers: sampler on client write path.
Maya (oncall): While rollout happens, add an automated eviction for clients exceeding 3 consecutive heartbeat misses and >10s buffer growth. This should evict pathological clients early.
Sam (runtime): Scripted eviction rule pushed. `evict_if: heartbeat_misses>=3 && queued_bytes>10240`. Starting on eu edge now.
Maya (oncall): Observability check: add trace annotation for streams that experienced >2s gap so we can link to client IDs and tenant. Lia, coordinate customer comms with Raj.
Lia (prodops): Noted. Drafting status update: "We've identified streaming gateway slow-consumer behavior causing delayed chunk delivery; mitigation in progress (evictions + chunking + proxy rotation)." Sending to Acme & NoteFlow now.
Raj (cust-success): Sent. Both teams appreciate quick update. They're asking for ETA to full mitigation. I'll pass: "30–45m dependent on EU rollout".
Sam (runtime): EU rollout shows p99 down to 850ms after evictions. Active slow-client count decreased by 73%.
Maya (oncall): Ok, moving to recovery phase. Actions to take before closing: - Keep drop+evict rules for 2 hours - Re-run `evict-slow-client` job globally with safe window - Schedule postmortem with RCA owner Sam - Collect top 10 tenants affected and session traces - Consider improving ALB idle/keepalive tuning to avoid retransmit backlog
Sam (runtime): Will own RCA. I'll also add telemetry to detect queued_bytes growth earlier (alert when median queued_bytes > 4k for 1m).
Lia (prodops): Rolling back temporary write-timeout increase to default. Leave chunking override and drop-flag for 2 hours as Maya said.
Maya (oncall): Monitoring for 10m more. If p99 stays <1.0s and errors normalized, we'll mark as mitigated.
Sam (runtime): p99 at 600ms cluster-wide now, streaming errors back to baseline. Active slow-client evictions: 1180 in last 40m.
Maya (oncall): Great. Marking as mitigated. Filing incident ticket: INC-975555 with timeline.
Lia (prodops): Incident ticket created and shared with CS. Postmortem assigned to Sam, due EOD tomorrow.
Raj (cust-success): Customers looped. No immediate SLA credits requested yet.
Maya (oncall): Final note: update runbook with eviction rule default and consider automated canary for chunking change. Good job team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: streaming.gateway.p99 back within SLO for 10m. Closing page.
